name: Laodicea

related_people.name: Nympha
related_people.role: hosted a house church that Paul greets in the letter to the Colossians

description: A wealthy city in the Lycus Valley near Colossae, home to Nympha's house church (Colossians 4:15-16), later addressed in Revelation and rebuked for being lukewarm — "neither cold nor hot" (Revelation 3:14-22).
